name: Yuriy Davidovich Sharapov
original_name: ユーリー・ダヴィードヴィチ・シャラポフ
source:
Likes: his daughter ([url=/c62609]Tatiana[/url]), research, tempura
Skill: knowledge of science in general
Role: deputy director of Hokuren Institute of Physical and Chemical Research

Born in Russia. He is a scientist working as the deputy director of Hokuren Institute of Physical and Chemical Research. He is Tatiana's father as well as an old friend of [url=/c62009]Owari[/url] and [url=/c62010]Iruka No. 2[/url] from their college days. While he is a rational scientist, he loses control over himself and turns into a doting parent when talking about his daughter Tatiana. However, he is busy as the deputy director and doesn't get to spend much time with her.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/yuriy.html]the official site[/url]]
